open_items: No guaranteed effective lower capacitance bounds or startup stability proof
C29 must retain >=10uF at 4.5V including temperature/tolerance/aging
Battery limits are operating assumptions, not measured discharge limits or an automatic cutoff
Nano separate branch protection/wiring/current budget and radio noise need validation
BAV199 forward voltage is not guaranteed to hold ADS input within AVSS-0.3/AVDD+0.3V
ADC injection-current limit is not a permissible body current
All electrode fault paths, aggregate current, unpowered backfeeding and bias-loop stability remain unresolved
